parsed.rationale: One participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/ path — an explicit sample-app restraint marker under the decision rules. Beyond that restraint, all eight members have empty 'fields_or_signature' lists, providing no concrete shared members to extract or consolidate. The types also span four unrelated packages (Playback, DebugPanel, Wallpaper, Intents) and represent structurally coincidental extensions of disparate domain concepts (IntentError, PlaybackState, ProcessInfo.ThermalState, TimeoutError), making any cross-package extraction semantically unjustified.
